answer: Each key registers a utility-signed smart meter for 18 epochs and answers six random demand-response pulses per epoch by shifting 2 kWh within five minutes. The utility signs meter ID, baseline, and result; validators verify signatures and merge keys sharing one service address or load trace. A plume may cross a terrace and leave an echo, but every extra fake needs another metered service and 216 kWh of controlled load, so 1,000 clones require 1,000 services and 216 MWh. Two misses burn the epoch reward; a forged reading slashes a 100-credit bond.
